payload.title: Land the 0.10.3 version bump and the claim-check CLI pin
payload.body: Land the 0.10.3 version bump (`bash scripts/sync-versions.sh 0.10.3`) on main in a PR with Task/Task-Claim trailers. After @tasks-md/cli 0.10.3 is on public npm (`curl -s https://registry.npmjs.org/@tasks-md/cli | jq -r '."dist-tags".latest'`), change `CLI_VERSION: "0.10.0"` to `CLI_VERSION: "0.10.3"` in .github/workflows/tasks-claim-check.yml.
